in_marathi.name: Dheeraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Brave, Strong, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheeraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dheeraj derives from the Sanskrit word ‘dheerah’, meaning ‘brave’, ‘strong’, and ‘radiant’. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a celestial being, Indra, who is the god of rain, thunder, and lightning. Dheeraj is a powerful and auspicious name, often given to boys to bless them with courage, strength, and prosperity.
